content:
According to reports, new Apple products will be announced on October 13, including the rumored "HomePad" device. But according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, one of the rumored products will not be released next month: a new full-size HomePod equipped with Siri AI.

Bloomberg reports that the large-size HomePod will not be updated in October, but a new version will "eventually" be released

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported today that Apple plans to soon announce three brand-new Home products.

The upcoming new products include:

The expected release date is Tuesday, October 13.

However, one major Home product will not be released in October. Gurman wrote:

This is the only place he mentions the large-size HomePod, which has not been updated since 2023.

Gurman reported earlier this year that a new full-size HomePod, an updated HomePod mini, and an Apple TV 4K are being developed simultaneously. When asked when they would be released, he said: "It's just a matter of time. They want to wait for Apple Intelligence and the new Siri features to work on these products before releasing new versions."

But despite Siri AI having already officially launched and the HomePod mini being ready to support it, fans of the large-size HomePod seem to have to wait a while longer before they can get a hardware update that supports Siri AI.

Hopefully the wait won't be too long, because in just a few more weeks, the full-size HomePod will be the only Home product still stuck on the old version of Siri.
